overview.description: The Vident U.S. Bond Strategy ETF (VBND) is an exchange-traded fund that is based on the Vident Core U.S. Bond index. The fund seeks current income and long-term capital appreciation by actively managing a portfolio of debt instruments primarily traded in the United States. Investments can be of any maturity or credit quality. VBND was launched on Oct 16, 2014 and is issued by Vident.
